name: book_appointment
description: Books an appointment in one of the business's calendars. Only call it after check_availability returned the chosen slot on this same call, and after the caller explicitly confirmed that exact date and time. Collect the caller's name before calling — never book under a placeholder or an invented name. Call it exactly once per booking; after it returns, confirm the booking back to the caller with the date, time and calendar timezone.

calendar_id.description: The id of the chosen calendar, copied exactly from scheduling_calendars.

date.description: The confirmed date as YYYY-MM-DD in the calendar's timezone.

start_time.description: The confirmed start time as HH:MM, copied from a slot check_availability returned on this call.

caller_name.description: The caller's name exactly as they stated it on this call. NEVER a placeholder or an invented name. If they have not given it, ask first.

notes.description: Only what the caller volunteered about the purpose of the appointment, in their own words. Omit when they gave nothing — never fabricate a description.
